definition: Content determination is the subtask of natural language generation (NLG) that involves deciding on the information to be communicated in a generated text.
details: It is closely related to the task of document structuring.
story: Think of a jazz musician who has heard so many solos that a new one simply falls out of their fingers. Given a starting line, the machine imagines what comes next — a word, a note, a patch of a picture. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. Creation, here, is memory recombined at speed. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Content determination.
